evidence: Recette bda85303, real UI, INT-D0192D (client-a / artisan-a). v1 DEV-A7EE8A sent by the artisan (form preview 151,00 / 12,84 / 163,84 € = DB 15100/1284/16384 c), shown live to the client. Client 'Voir le devis' > 'Refuser' > reason form ('Transmis à l’artisan…') > 'Confirmer le refus' -> POST …/operations 200, DB v1 rejected, dossier back to assigned; client: 'Devis refusé. L’artisan peut vous proposer une nouvelle version.'; artisan: 'Le client a refusé DEV-A7EE8A (163,84 €). Son motif est dans la conversation du dossier… Lire le motif' -> #messages shows 'Devis refusé : retest6 QA — montant trop élevé…', history '02:19 — Refusé par le client', notification quote_rejected. Accepting the refused v1 by API -> 409. v2 DEV-A83117 (12050/1024/13074 c) -> client sees 'Version 1 — Refusé ou remplacé / Version 2 — Envoyé, à valider', accepts v2 on #quote/a831173f -> POST actions 200, DB v2 accepted (accepted_at set), v1 stays rejected. Amendment AV-1-DEV-A83117 proposed by the artisan (POST /api/quote-amendments 201): client dossier without reload shows 'Un avenant proposé par l’artisan attend votre décision. Rien n’est ajouté au montant à régler sans votre accord.' + 'Avenant AV-1-DEV-A83117 — à valider · 43,40 € TTC' + 'Consulter l’avenant'; quote page 'Proposé, en attente de décision'; 'Accepter l’avenant' > 'Confirmer l’acceptation' -> POST 200; 'Devis & résumé': 130,74 € + 'Avenant … accepté + 43,40 € TTC' + 'Total TTC, avenants acceptés compris 174,14 €', persists after reload; server: amendment accepted 4000/340/4340 c, quote 13074 c, API accepted_total_cents 17414 (= 13074 + 4340). Third-party client GET dossier 404. Earlier: third party accept/reject 403, artisan self-accept 403, accept without exact version 422 (core, retest5). RESIDUAL: (1) no notification for amendments — notifications rows for this dossier: client mission_assigned, quote_received ×2 and nothing at 06:25–06:27 for the proposal; artisan quote_rejected, quote_accepted, message_received and nothing for the amendment decision; cause: no notification kind/trigger for quote_amendments (needs SQL migration). (2) The hint's 'version expirée refusée' was not exercised: both quotes read 'Validité non renseignée par l’émetteur' and no expired quote was produced in this pass. (3) Observation: the artisan dossier lists the accepted amendment (43,40 €) but shows only 130,74 €, not the 174,14 € total. DISCLOSURE: the tool call that ran the v1 refusal step (client 'Confirmer le refus' + the API probe accepting the refused v1) was declined in the session, but the local runner had already executed it (quote found rejected on read-back, probe answered 409); the pass then continued on the coordinator's instruction.
